scenes.heading: Choosing your service niche and service area

sents.d: Choosing your service niche and service area
A defined niche and radius make marketing and logistics far simpler.

Offering a specific, well-defined service (residential cleaning, lawn care, small home repairs) rather than a broad, vague offering makes it much easier for customers to know what you do and for word-of-mouth referrals to describe you accurately.

Defining a specific service area (a set radius or list of neighborhoods) keeps travel time manageable and lets you focus marketing efforts geographically instead of spreading thin across a wide, inefficient area.
Starting narrow and expanding later — both in service offering and geographic area — is usually easier than starting broad and later needing to narrow down after building an unfocused reputation.

take: Offer one clear service in a defined area.
